group_note: extracted from a mis-extensioned .rar that was actually a POSIX tar with ../ member paths; boots via /adm/single/master (an unused adm/obj/master.lpc bundled in the tree happens to byte-match the jyqxc/fy2mg/xkx2017 framework family, but isn't the one actually loaded); boots clean with zero fixes needed. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc; fixed the euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc's make_body(); fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds; guarded securityd.lpc's get_status() defensively; fixed the classic §7.49 save_object-extension-mismatch bug in securityd.lpc's valid_write(). The big find: SIMUL_EFUN_OB in include/globals.h pointed at a stale, unused /adm/single/simul_efun.lpc (a dead-code duplicate from an earlier reorg, present in the tree but not referenced by config.fluffos's 'simulated efun file' setting) instead of the REAL /adm/obj/simul_efun.lpc that config.fluffos actually loads and that defines the destruct() override. This broke feature/move.lpc's remove() security check (which validates previous_object() against SIMUL_EFUN_OB) on every single object destruct routed through that override -- concretely, it broke `quit` for EVERY new player, since quit's auto-drop-inventory logic destructs any worthless dropped item (every fresh character starts with one). The bug was silent: the connection printed a caught runtime error and looked like it disconnected, but the character was actually still logged in and the world-side connection never actually closed. Fixed by pointing the macro at the real file (same instinct as the securityd.lpc/securd.lpc duplicate-file trap from an earlier lib -- always verify a path macro against config.fluffos/the actual call trace before trusting it, even for macros that look definitively canonical). Also fixed a genuinely corrupted bulletin-board save (data/board/kedian_b.o had raw non-UTF-8 GBK bytes in a post's author field, crashing every `look` in that room) by removing the corrupted save file outright rather than attempting a risky partial byte-level re-encode. Admin seeded via the plain-text adm/etc/wizlist file. Registration through world-entry, look/score, and a CORRECTLY COMPLETING quit are all cleanly verified -- re-test quit specifically on any lib sharing this SIMUL_EFUN_OB/duplicate-simul_efun-file shape.
